findings: Front-camera body-ray tests identify 377 to 1008 curves in front of the facial clear zone.
All three variants preserve zero penetration over the four motion-gate frames.
Radius-zero masking still leaves the rejected curves visible and exposes a darker inner curtain.
The ray classification is useful, but the removal mechanism must delete topology rather than edit radius.
decision: Retain the ray classifier and reject the radius-mask implementation.
